metadata.runtimeScope: Existing UI component in API mode, local dispatcher and D1, synthetic sessions and TEST agent

limitations: Local browser checks mount the existing UI component at the recorded UI commit in API mode. Vinext/Sites route integration and hosted access require separate verification.
Synthetic local sessions and a TEST agent are used. Agent-fault cases exercise the real validator with offline provider transport. Default LIVE failure labels do not establish a real provider call.
The pending-acknowledgement test bridges a genuine immutable D1 acknowledgement to the browser before releasing its held evaluation.
The user confirmed that no hosted environment is available. DEP-N01 and DEP-N02 were not run. AUTH-N03 has local denials/trust checks with its hosted override clause unverified.
